US.description: This bike is for racers obsessed with achieving the perfect balance of aerodynamics, weight and rigidity. RCR-R stands for "racer", because that's who it's for.

components.description: SRAM Rival disc brakes with 160 mm discs at the front and 140 mm at the back.

The SRAM Rival brakes are hydraulic. This gives you progressive, more powerful braking than with cable-actuated hydraulic brakes.; You will need to bed these brakes in. Simply brake gradually 20 times at a low speed (20 km/h), then repeat at 30 km/h. Make sure to bed in both brakes.
Bedding in creates more friction between the disc and brake pad.
